title: Runtime Characterization Scenario
description: One observed-behavior scenario captured during discovery. Domain-neutral: no source or target technology is named in this schema.

$schema.description: Scheme-less relative path from the instance file to its schema file.

schema_version.description: Instance schema version. Major component pinned to the v1 directory; minor and patch are free.

title.description: Short human-readable name of the scenario.

preconditions.description: Preconditions that hold before the stimulus is applied.

description.description: What was done to the system.

inputs.description: Optional free-form inputs supplied with the stimulus.

stimulus.description: The stimulus applied to the system under observation.

description.description: What the system did in response.

observed_behavior.description: The observed behavior in response to the stimulus.

evidence_refs.description: Evidence Reference id values. A characterization without evidence is not a characterization.

description.description: What varied relative to the base scenario.

observed_behavior.description: The behavior observed under this variation.

identifier.description: Shared identifier grammar. Lowercase alphanumeric start; dots, underscores, and hyphens permitted.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp enforced by regex because the validator runs without a FormatChecker.

metadata.title: Free-form consumer metadata
metadata.description: Sanctioned extension point. Additional properties are permitted here only.
